dct_description_sm: This tabular dataset lists 74 medication drop-box and mail-back-envelope locations in Milwaukee County, Wisconsin. The locations provide secure disposal options for unused, unwanted, or expired medications. Records contain municipality and street address. The source portal identifies February 2025 as the most recent update.
Original source: City of Milwaukee Open Data Portal.
